name: storm-writer
title: Research a topic through parallel interviews, then write it up

origin.source: LangGraph STORM research-writer tutorial (Shao et al. 2024)

comparison.purpose: Drafts an outline, picks editor perspectives, runs one interview per editor in parallel against a sample source index, refines the outline from what the interviews found, and writes the article one section at a time. Each interview is its own spawned child machine with a turn cap, and editor count, turn count, and section count are exported constants checked by guards, with overflow dropped and counted rather than left to a router function and recursion_limit.

starters: the history of the Byzantine Empire (off-index: interviews find no sample sources)
